title: Foveation is set but the renderer is Forward+
evidence: Only works on the Compatibility rendering method
suggestion: xr/openxr/foveation_level has no effect on Forward+ in Godot 4.4. The 4.4 description says it only works on Compatibility. Godot 4.7's description no longer says that, so this rule is 4.4 only.
tradeoff: Switching renderer changes the whole pipeline.
expected_effect: Re-measure with collect_metrics after changing this setting. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: Foveation is not using subsampled images
evidence: This can improve the performance gain from foveated rendering
suggestion: Turn xr/openxr/foveation_with_subsampled_images on when foveation is enabled on Vulkan. The 4.7 description says subsampled images improve the gain and conflict with some screen-space effects.
expected_effect: Re-measure with collect_metrics after changing this setting. No frame-time percentage is predicted.

title: An XR project reads the screen texture
heuristic_rationale: A configured feature is a measurement candidate, not proof that it is currently visible, costly or unnecessary. Numeric review thresholds are Render Lens heuristics, not Godot limits.
evidence: xr/openxr/enabled is on and a spatial ShaderMaterial declares a hint_screen_texture uniform, or a BaseMaterial3D enables refraction (which samples the screen texture); comments are ignored. The page adds that Godot then makes a full copy of the render buffer. Godot docs: "Full screen effects that require reading from the screen texture effectively disable all rendering performance optimizations in XR."
suggestion: Write XR full-screen effects as per-pixel shaders that do not sample the screen (the page's vignette example), and avoid refraction on XR-visible materials.
tradeoff: Effects that distort or blur the rendered image need the screen texture.
expected_effect: Potentially reduce work for this feature; no frame-time saving is predicted from configuration alone.
verify_step: Capture a visual reference; change one feature and repeat frame timing plus relevant CPU or GPU profiling in the same scene on target hardware.

title: An OpenXR composition layer has sort order 0
evidence: Godot prints "Composition layer returned sort order 0, it may be overwritten by projection layer." when an OpenXRCompositionLayer's sort_order is 0, the order of the main projection layer, so the runtime may draw the scene over it.
suggestion: Use a positive sort_order to draw the layer in front of the scene, or a negative one to draw it behind.
expected_effect: Godot uses the configuration as written instead of overriding or ignoring it; no performance saving is asserted.
verify_step: audit_project_rendering or scan_scene, then run the game and confirm the warning is gone from the output

title: OpenXR frame synthesis is requested under Forward+
evidence: Godot prints "OpenXR: Frame synthesis not supported for this rendering method!" when xr/openxr/extensions/frame_synthesis is on and the project renders with Forward+ on Vulkan; Godot unregisters the extension, so no frames are synthesized. Mobile on Vulkan and Compatibility support it; Direct3D 12 and Metal reject it as a driver instead.
suggestion: Use the Mobile renderer for XR projects that rely on frame synthesis, or turn the setting off.
tradeoff: The Mobile renderer drops Forward+-only effects.
expected_effect: Godot uses the configuration as written instead of overriding or ignoring it; no performance saving is asserted.
verify_step: audit_project_rendering or scan_scene, then run the game and confirm the warning is gone from the output

title: Physics object picking is expected in a stereo XR viewport
evidence: Godot prints "Object picking can't be used when stereo rendering, this will be turned off!" once a stereo XR interface renders a viewport that has physics object picking on: a SubViewport with use_xr and physics_object_picking, or an OpenXR project whose root viewport picks (physics/common/enable_object_picking) while scene objects listen for input_event. Godot then turns picking off, so those listeners get no mouse or pointer events.
suggestion: Use XR pointer raycasts (RayCast3D or a pointer tool) for interaction, and turn object picking off for XR viewports.
tradeoff: Pointer raycasts need their own interaction code.
expected_effect: Godot uses the configuration as written instead of overriding or ignoring it; no performance saving is asserted.
verify_step: audit_project_rendering or scan_scene, then run the game and confirm the warning is gone from the output

title: An XR project uses a canvas environment background on Mobile
evidence: Godot prints "Canvas background is not supported in multiview!" when an Environment uses background mode Canvas in an OpenXR project under the Mobile renderer; stereo (multiview) rendering cannot show the canvas behind the scene.
suggestion: Use a sky, color or passthrough background in XR.
expected_effect: Godot uses the configuration as written instead of overriding or ignoring it; no performance saving is asserted.
verify_step: audit_project_rendering or scan_scene, then run the game and confirm the warning is gone from the output

title: Subsampled foveation is disabled by post-processing on Mobile
evidence: Godot prints "Foveation with subsampled images was enabled, but rendering features are in use that have forced it to be disabled." on headsets with the FB foveation extension when xr/openxr/foveation_with_subsampled_images is on (the default) and the Mobile renderer cannot finish post-processing in a subpass: glow, depth of field, auto-exposure, a canvas background, screen or depth texture reads (shaders, refraction, proximity fade), transparent-stage compositor effects, screen-space AA or a 3D scale other than 1 (render_forward_mobile.cpp).
suggestion: Remove those features from the XR view to keep subsampled foveation, or turn the setting off.
tradeoff: Dropping glow or depth of field changes the look.
expected_effect: Godot uses the configuration as written instead of overriding or ignoring it; no performance saving is asserted.
verify_step: audit_project_rendering or scan_scene, then run the game and confirm the warning is gone from the output
